title: Rav Chananyah bar Bibi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesachim 110a: Rav Ashi said, “I saw Rav Chananyah bar Bibi go out and look toward the marketplace after each cup.” Yuchasin considers him a grandson of Abaye.[^1][^2]

notes.text: דאכל כסא is understood as “after each cup,” preserving the repeated action in הוה נפיק וחזי, “he would go out and look.” The William Davidson vocalized text of Pesachim 110a has the corresponding form דאכל כסא; its English explicitly reads “each cup.”
Hyman attributes the claim that Chananyah was Abaye’s grandson to Yuchasin (היוחסין). The title is retained without supplying an author or binding that genealogy independently.
